description: Reference hook config in the schema Claude Code plugins use (${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}). This harness is installed by symlink, not as a registered plugin, so this file is NOT read automatically — the actual registration for a symlink install lives in the user's ~/.claude/settings.json, written by scripts/install/register-session-start-hook.js (run by install.sh/install.ps1). Kept here as a correct-schema reference and for a future real plugin.json conversion, should that ever happen.
